subject: The one mistake 90% of users make with AI summaries
preview_text: It's not about the AI. It's about what you do BEFORE the meeting. This 60-second hack changes everything.
body_paragraphs: Confession: I used to think the magic was in the AI summary after the meeting. I was wrong. The real power is in the 60 seconds BEFORE you hit record. Most people open the app when the meeting starts and just let it run. That's a huge mistake.

Here's the secret: the AI isn't just listening to words. It's listening for intent. If you give it zero context, you get a generic summary. But if you spend 60 seconds typing a one-line goal for the meeting in the 'Meeting Goal' field (it's that little text box at the top before you record), the AI transforms. It becomes your personal analyst. It will highlight decisions that align with or threaten that goal. It will flag action items that directly serve it. It turns a transcript into a strategic briefing.

This is the hidden feature that makes Smart Notes 10x more useful. It's not just a note-taker; it's a goal-tracking system. The AI uses your stated goal to weight importance, categorize points, and even suggest follow-ups. The summary you get isn't just 'what was said'—it's 'what matters for your objective.'

Open the app right now. Don't schedule a meeting. Just tap 'New Meeting,' type a fake goal like 'Plan Q3 marketing budget,' and see how the interface shifts. Feel the difference. Then, use it for your next real call. You'll never run a meeting blind again. P.S. The users who do this save an average of 30 minutes per meeting review. They're the ones who look prepared, drive outcomes, and never miss a key point.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes & Try the Goal Hack
